description: Installation of a new shop front
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Design and access statement], Received: 31/07/2020, [2020-30-001A], [2020-30-002A], [2020-30-003B], [2020-30-004D], Received: 23/09/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The doors hereby approved shall be clearly defined with visual manifestations on the glass at two levels: between 850 mm to 1000 mm and 1400 mm to 1600 mm above ground level. The manifestations shall be fixed to, painted on or etched into the glass in the form of a continuous or broken (by no more than 20 mm) horizontal band 50 mm high, or a series of signs or logos at least 150 mm high spaced no further than 300 mm apart.  The manifestations shall visually contrast with their surroundings when viewed from both inside and outside the building in all lighting conditions.
